name: o-matic-wordpress-factory
description: Host-aware WordPress and Elementor MCP plugin. Tools, not people - the agents ship separately in o-MATIC Studio.

canonical_format.contract: The MCP servers are the canonical WordPress and Elementor tool surfaces. Bundled SKILL.md files are canonical prompt contracts and must not fork per platform.

mcp_hosts.notes: Full operation requires an MCP-capable host that can launch the WordPress and Elementor connector servers and provide project credentials or profile config. Host config shapes differ and are NOT interchangeable: Claude Code / Cowork / Gemini CLI use an mcpServers map; Codex uses mcp_servers (TOML) or a bare server map in the file .codex-plugin/plugin.json's mcpServers field points at; VS Code Copilot uses a servers map with an explicit per-server type. See config/examples/.

prompt_only_hosts.notes: Prompt-only hosts can load bundled skills as behavior instructions, but cannot perform WordPress or Elementor actions unless connected through an external MCP bridge or separate tool adapter. google-gemini was listed here until 2026-09-06 and that was WRONG - Gemini CLI has native MCP support via ~/.gemini/settings.json mcpServers and is now a full mcp_host. Verified against google-gemini.github.io/gemini-cli/docs/tools/mcp-server.

claude.notes: Claude Code plugin manifest starts MCP servers and loads bundled skills.

codex.notes: Codex plugin manifest loads skills and .mcp.json starts the MCP servers.

cowork.notes: Use the same server entry points with explicit WordPress or Elementor environment variables/profile config.

google.notes: Gemini CLI launches the WordPress and Elementor connectors natively. Per-server fields: command, args, env, cwd, timeout, trust (plus url/httpUrl for remote transports). env values accept $VAR_NAME indirection. Verified against vendor docs 2026-09-06.

ollama.notes: Build a Modelfile from a bundled SKILL.md for local prompt behavior. No site tools are available unless the local app wraps Ollama with MCP/tool calls.

generic.notes: Load the selected SKILL.md as a system/developer instruction. Treat WordPress and Elementor actions as unavailable unless the runtime provides matching tools.

copilot.settings_path: <workspace>/.vscode/mcp.json, or the user profile file opened via 'MCP: Open User Configuration'
copilot.notes: VS Code Copilot Chat launches the connectors natively. The top-level key is servers, NOT mcpServers, and each server declares an explicit type (stdio or http). Use the inputs block for secrets so the application password is prompted at server start rather than stored in the file. Decision #304 covered SKILL.md loading only; this closes the tool/MCP half. Verified against vendor docs 2026-09-06.

bundled_skills_note: Supply ships TOOLS, not people. Brandy, Carver, Jo, Monet and Pixel moved to o-MATIC Studio because a plugin declaring an mcpServers block is omitted by hosted-marketplace hosts - bundling them here once cost four agents on restricted hosts. Do not re-add them: two copies at two versions with no authority is the failure this split fixed.
